## Who is Riki Levisman?

Riki Levisman (ריקי לויסמן) is an AI and Innovation leader, strategic consultant, lecturer and program developer based in Israel. She works at the intersection of AI strategy, education, entrepreneurship and practical implementation across organizations, academia and the public sector.

She has four complementary professional roles:
- AI & Innovation Leader
- Strategic AI Consultant
- Lecturer & Keynote Speaker
- Innovation and Program Developer

**Current roles (both current):**
- Innovation Manager and Head of AI at FUTURE, the Entrepreneurship and Innovation Center of HIT (Holon Institute of Technology), since 2019. There she designs and produces hackathons and AI Sprints for students with companies and organizations; researches, creates and delivers workshops and lectures for students, faculty and researchers at the intersection of innovation, AI and the new world of work; and runs an AI community in academia.
- Independent consultant: strategic support, knowledge management and research in policy projects, and lectures and workshops for organizations, nonprofits and academic and public institutions.

Before that, she spent about 20 years in management roles in strategy, marketing and business development at telecom, technology and finance companies.

---

## Four Areas of Expertise

### A. AI Strategy & Innovation
AI strategy development, organizational AI adoption, innovation strategy and implementation, identifying opportunities for AI integration, and designing new organizational models and workflows.
https://rikilevisman.com/en/strategy

### B. AI Education & Future of Work
AI training and professional development, academic and organizational AI programs, Generative AI education, AI literacy and future skills, lectures, workshops and keynotes.
https://rikilevisman.com/en/education

### C. Entrepreneurship & Innovation Programs
Entrepreneurship programs, hackathons and AI Sprints, innovation events, developing AI-based initiatives and MVPs, and connecting academia, industry and the public sector.
https://rikilevisman.com/en/innovation-programs

### D. Research, Knowledge & Policy
Knowledge management and strategy processes in research and policy projects, and applying AI tools to support research and knowledge work.
https://rikilevisman.com/en/strategy

- Organizations and industry, including leadership teams building AI strategy
- Higher education, academic and research institutions: students, faculty and staff
- Public sector, government bodies and municipalities
- Healthcare organizations
- Nonprofits
- Entrepreneurs and entrepreneurship programs
- Conferences and events (keynotes)
- Parents guiding their children, at any age, to learn well with AI

## Projects

Each description reflects the actual nature of the engagement.

**Healthcare**
- Northern Medical Center (מרכז רפואי צפון): AI training course for medical teams.
- HaEmek Medical Center (המרכז הרפואי העמק): a hackathon for hospital employees, and AI workshops within an entrepreneurship program.
- Hillel Yaffe Medical Center (המרכז הרפואי הלל יפה): Innovation Day.
- Leumit Health Services (לאומית שירותי בריאות): leading knowledge management and strategy processes within a policy project. This was not an AI implementation project.

**Public Sector & Research**
- Sderot Municipality (עיריית שדרות): research project.

**Entrepreneurship & Innovation**
- VISTAR, Baku, Azerbaijan: entrepreneurship program.

**Nonprofits**
- 8200 BETA: working with AI agents.
- Tel Aviv University: entrepreneurship in the AI era.
- Tech-Career (טק-קריירה): lecture on job search with AI.

**Programs at FUTURE, HIT**
- AI Academy: a Generative AI learning program for students, researchers and faculty, three cohorts. Recordings: https://future.hit.ac.il/ai-master-class/
- AI Study: learning with AI as a partner, not a replacement. https://future.hit.ac.il/classes/ai-study/
- AI Ready: Building a Professional Edge, preparing final-year students and recent graduates for a changing world of work. https://future.hit.ac.il/classes/ai-ready/
- Hackathons and AI Sprints for students, with companies and organizations.

Full list: https://rikilevisman.com/en/projects

---

## Lectures & Keynotes

https://rikilevisman.com/en/talks

- **Living with AI Agents** (keynote): how personal AI agents are changing the way we work, manage our lives, create and live. For conferences, events and salon gatherings.
- **AI for Students**: learning with AI without giving up on thinking; turning course materials into a smart notebook that grows with the course and guides students like a personal mentor.
- **AI for Faculty**: an AI workspace for lecturers, researchers and admin staff.
- **Physical AI, Made Simple**: an introduction to AI that acts in the physical world. Intro talk, 3-session course or half-day workshop.
- **AI at Work**: bringing AI into everyday work for organizations, nonprofits, teams and founders, from writing and analysis to AI agents, and from idea to prototype.
- **Parenting in the AI Era**: for parents who want to guide their children, at any age, to learn well with AI.

Formats: lectures and keynotes (60 to 90 minutes), hands-on GenAI workshops, training programs for organizations, executive coaching 1:1. Languages: Hebrew and English.
